digest.component_or_area: capabilities.py - tier derivation for signed verdicts
propositions: A run using a gateway/* provider (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, etc.) is incorrectly stamped tier: first_class even though the request traversed an intermediary that can rewrite it
The tier derivation at capabilities.py:307-311 checks only base_url but not provider name, allowing gateway providers without base_url to misrepresent provenance in signed verdicts
Direct providers (anthropic, bedrock, openai, google-cloud, groq) with no base_url correctly remain first_class and must not be collateral damage from the fix
Gateway providers must be detected by exact provider name membership check, not prefix matching, to enforce architectural guard against startswith-style provider name matching
